title: Improving Signals, Declining Encoder: A Known-Answer Test of Label-Free Monitoring in Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-supervised training is monitored without labels, through the loss and statistics of the learned features. We report a case where we know the encoders lost part of what they had learned, so we can check whether these signals noticed. We trained LeJEPA encoders on synthetic images with known generating factors. In nine of ten seeds, the readability of those factors fell abruptly and stayed down, nearly always along the same direction in factor space. Meanwhile the loss kept falling, and most of the eleven label-free signals we tracked kept improving and rated the declining runs better than runs that did not decline. Standard change-point detection rarely flagged the decline near its onset, and selecting checkpoints by these signals mostly chose ones after it.

translated_title: 信号在改善，编码器在退化：自监督学习中无标签监测的已知答案测试
translated_abstract: 自监督训练通常在没有标签的情况下进行监测，依靠损失和学习到的特征的统计量。我们报告了一个案例，其中我们知道编码器丢失了它们已经学到的部分内容，因此可以检验这些信号是否察觉到了这一点。我们在具有已知生成因子的合成图像上训练了LeJEPA编码器。在十个随机种子中的九个中，这些因子的可读性突然下降并持续保持低位，且几乎总是沿着因子空间中的同一方向发生。与此同时，损失持续下降，我们跟踪的十一个无标签信号中的大多数持续改善，并且将发生退化的运行评得比未发生退化的运行更好。标准的变点检测很少在退化开始时附近发出警报，而通过这些信号选择检查点时，大多数情况下选中的是退化发生之后的检查点。
tldr: 该论文通过已知答案的合成数据实验揭示，自监督学习中常用的无标签监测信号（如损失和特征统计量）无法察觉编码器的实际退化，甚至会给退化中的训练更高的评分，从而可能误导检查点选择。
en_tdlr: Through a known-answer test on synthetic data, the paper reveals that common label-free monitoring signals in self-supervised learning—such as loss and feature statistics—fail to detect actual encoder degradation and may even favor it, potentially misleading checkpoint selection.
